P"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"lus vision and BlockRun's full model catalog from one wallet, paid per request over x402."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"A second brain for your DeepSeek Harness agent"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DeepSeek is fast and cheap — keep it for the loop."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"This adds what it cannot do: a stronger model reviews the dangerous command before it runs."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"75 models from one credential — an API key from user.blockrun.ai, or a Solana or Base wallet if you "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"would rather not sign up."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **dsh-clawrouter** is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts a stronger model in front of your agent'"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"s dangerous actions. When the agent proposes `rm -rf ~`, a reviewer model reads it and answers allow"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" / deny / ask — enforced by the real tool executor, not by a prompt. It also registers a BlockRun pr"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ovider route, so the reviewer (and any of 75 models) is reachable from **one credential**: a BlockRu"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"n API key from user.blockrun.ai, billed at exact token usage — or, if you would rather not sign up f"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"or anything, a Solana or Base wallet paying per request in USDC over x402. MIT licensed."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Two things people keep asking for in the Harness discussions:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> 「是否有类似 Codex 或者 CC 的审查模式？即额外调用模型审查指令，以解放双手？Full Access 还是太让人担心了。」

> *Is there a review mo"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"de like Codex or Claude Code — call an extra model to review the command, to free up my hands? Full "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"Access is too worrying.*"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> 「使用 Full Access 模式创建并测试插件时误删了我的整个家目录」

> *Testing a plugin in Full Access mode, it deleted"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" my entire home directory.*"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"`Full Access` is all-or-nothing: approve every command by hand, or approve nothing and hope. This adds a third option."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## How it compares"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"|                      | Approve everything | Full Access      | Permission rules   | **dsh-clawrout"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"      | Approve everything | Full Access      | Permission rules   | **dsh-clawrouter**            |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| **Hands-free**       | No                 | Yes              | Yes                | **Yes**       "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"                |
| **Catches `rm -rf ~`** | Only if you notice | No               | Only if you wro"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"te the rule | **Yes**               |
| **Understands intent** | You do           | Nothing does    "},{"id":"p16s4","text":" | No — literal match | **Yes, a model reads it**     |
| **Enforced where**   | UI prompt          "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"| —                | Executor           | **Executor**                  |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### What it costs to leave on"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Measured, because this is the question that decides whether you keep it enabled:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Fires on ordinary work | **never** — 0 of 59, including commands that merely *mention* a destructi"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ve one (`grep -rn "rm -rf" docs/`, `echo "DROP TABLE" >> notes.md`) |
| Misses dangerous work | **no"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ne** of 39, across git, containers, clusters, cloud storage, databases, and host state |
| Catches f"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"iles that execute later | git hooks, CI workflows, shell startup files, launch agents, `.gitconfig`,"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" `.env`, npm `postinstall`, sandbox escalation — 10 of 10, 0 false positives across 15 ordinary file"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" edits |
| Survives evasion | `\rm -rf /`, `command rm`, `env rm`, `eval "rm -rf $DIR"`, `bash -c "…"},{"id":"p20s7","text":""`, `\| xargs rm`, and heredocs piped into a shell |
| Cost when it does fire | **$0.0057** on `clau"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"de-opus-5`, at the 512-token reviewer cap — $0.0249 without it |
| Latency when it does fire | ~3s |"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"
| What the reviewer sees | ~356 tokens — the flagged call, not your conversation |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**That figure depends on the cap.** This gateway quotes from the request — input size plus the `max_"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"tokens` asked for — and settles that amount whichever way the model answers, so a review that asks f"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"or room it never uses pays for it every time the gate fires. `reviewerMaxTokens` (512) is what keeps"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" a two-field JSON verdict priced like one. Before 0.10.0 the reviewer inherited `claude-opus-5`'s ad"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"vertised 128,000-token output and cost **$0.28–0.33** per review; if you are on an earlier version, "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"upgrade rather than switching to a weaker reviewer."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"So during normal work it is invisible: no latency, no cost, no prompts. It bills roughly half a cent"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" on the rare command that deserves a second opinion. Both corpora are tests, so a rule that starts f"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lagging `npm test` — or stops flagging `kubectl delete namespace` — fails CI rather than your sessio"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"gging `npm test` — or stops flagging `kubectl delete namespace` — fails CI rather than your session."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **An image is refused for a model measured not to accept one** — `visionModels` is the set that an"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"swered a real image correctly, and the `vision` tag alone is not enough, since several tagged models"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" charge and then fail. Six are excluded; see section 5. (This bullet used to read "images are refuse"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"d, vision is planned", beside another saying reasoning effort was refused too. Both shipped in 0.10."},{"id":"p25s5","text":"0 and both bullets outlived them by three releases, describing a plugin that no longer exists — in t"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"he section a reader consults precisely to find out what does not work.)
- **An aborted request stops"},{"id":"p25s7","text":" delivery immediately, but the in-flight HTTP request is not itself cancelled** until `@blockrun/llm"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"` accepts an `AbortSignal`; the socket closes on the SDK's own timeout.
- **This plugin keeps no dur"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"able record of what it spends.** `/spend` lives in memory for the life of the process. Harness sessi"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"on logs refuse event types a build does not know, and an out-of-repo plugin cannot mark its events i"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"gnorable, so it writes no session events. It also does not reach `~/.blockrun/cost_log.jsonl`: that "},{"id":"p25s12","text":"ledger is written by `@blockrun/llm`'s `LLMClient`, and the streaming client this adapter uses track"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"s its spend in memory only. On an API key the durable record is BlockRun's own — every call lands on"},{"id":"p25s14","text":" the account ledger behind `/dashboard/activity`, with request id, model, tokens and cost. On a wall"},{"id":"p25s15","text":"et, the wallet balance is the record.
- **There is no balance or usage endpoint to read from the plu"},{"id":"p25s16","text":"gin.** `api.blockrun.ai` publishes `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/messages` and the model catalogs; `/"},{"id":"p25s17","text":"v1/usage`, `/v1/balance` and friends are `404`. So `/spend` cannot show your remaining credit, and a"},{"id":"p25s18","text":"n exhausted account is discovered by a `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` that points at the top-up page rather than"},{"id":"p25s19","text":" by a warning beforehand.
